t: NixOS Modularization & AI Agents: Overcoming Unfree Licenses
s: This article details refactoring a monolithic NixOS configuration into modular components using AI agents like Gemini CLI, focusing on practical delegation of tasks, debugging, and iterative verification for improved infrastructure management.
sub: Modularizing NixOS configuration with AI agents
Delegating system tasks to AI code assistants (Gemini CLI)
Addressing 'unfree license' errors in NixOS package management
